name: Glissa's Retriever
oracle_text:
Haste, toxic 3 (Players dealt combat damage by this creature also get three poison counters.)
This creature can't be blocked by creatures with power 2 or less.
Corrupted — When this creature dies, exile it. When you do, return up to X target cards from your graveyard to your hand, where X is the number of opponents who have three or more poison counters.
blocked_sentences: Corrupted — When this creature dies, exile it. When you do, return up to X target cards from your graveyard to your hand, where X is the number of opponents who have three or more poison counters.

needs.what: a value counting the players a spec names who EACH have at least N poison counters -- e.g. {"player_count": {"player": "each_opponent", "poison": {">=": 3}}} or a player-spec filter {"each_opponent", "min_poison": 3} -- so a reflexive trigger's card_in_graveyard target can be `count: <that value>, up_to: true` ("up to X target cards, where X is the number of opponents who have three or more poison counters")
needs.why_existing_wont_do: max_poison_of gives only the single highest poison total (so it can say 'an opponent has 3+ poison', not how many do); player_count's comparing form compares a count of OBJECTS per player (validate_per_player_count accepts only player/objects), and poison counters live on PlayerState, not on objects; select_players has no poison filter. In a multiplayer pod, a max_poison_of>=3 -> 1 stand-in would cap X at 1 when two or three opponents are corrupted
